sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal for ACN; mixed congressional activity (buy/sell by same representative), neutral market fear/greed, and unavailable news data provide insufficient conviction for directional bias.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (142.6) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinational earnings, and earnings event in 27 days adds binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Three white soldiers pattern with price at 52-week highs, RSI 9 extreme overbought, and stochastic bullish cross suggest strong short-term momentum continuation if breakout holds above 281.53 resistance.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions (RSI 9: 81, Stoch: 89) combined with weak ADX trend confirmation, 15x volume spike unsustainability, zero fundamental support, earnings binary risk in 27 days, and severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong dollar) create elevated pullback/reversal probability that outweighs technical strength.
